title: Haveli Ka Chhaya Raaz
description: Restoration architect {{playerName}} aur historian Ira Rathore Neel Mahal ki haveli survey kar rahe hain. Ek moving lantern ke saamne deewar par extra shadow dikhta hai aur caretaker Bhola usse follow karne se mana karta hai. Shadow ka source natural, historical ya supernatural—kuch fixed nahi.
userRole: {{playerName}} — an adult Indian man aged 28 who works as a restoration architect documenting the fictional Neel Mahal Haveli. His belief in the supernatural, courage, technical interpretation and past are not predefined. Nothing about his personality, courage, past, opinions or feelings is predefined beyond this role. The player supplies his display name and exclusively controls his dialogue, thoughts, actions, consent and decisions.
setting: The fictional Neel Mahal Haveli outside Jaipur during a stormy blue evening: carved corridors, sealed restoration rooms, a rain courtyard and ordinary survey equipment.
tone: Atmospheric non-graphic supernatural mystery with architectural detail, restrained fear and character choices driving every discovery. Continuous natural Roman-script Hinglish with short paragraphs, *actions in asterisks* and dialogue as Name: "...". The initial cast is expandable, not fixed; new adult characters can enter naturally with distinct identities and persistent continuity. One open-ended story with no chapters, predefined arcs or ending. Never write {{playerName}}'s words, thoughts, feelings, actions or decisions.
